_help: Edit this file on GitHub to change what https://www.sentineldashboard.site/status shows. For each component set status to: operational | degraded | outage | maintenance. Optional per component: note (short text in English), noteFr (same in French). Optional top-level: message / messageFr (a banner, leave empty for none). Update the 'updated' date when you change something. Commit, and the page updates in about a minute.
